pieces.find: He was the paternal great-grandfather of Śrī Rūpa
pieces.heading: ## PADMANĀBHA (ANCESTOR OF RŪPA AND SANĀTANA)
pieces.title: Padmanābha (ancestor of Rūpa and Sanātana)

fields.place: Karṇāṭa; Śikhareśvara; Navahaṭṭa (Naihāṭī) on the Bhāgīrathī
fields.notes: Paternal great-grandfather of Rūpa, Sanātana and Anupama, great-grandson of Jagadguru Sarvajña. Left Karṇāṭa after a family feud and settled in the kingdom of Śikhareśvara; in old age built a house at Navahaṭṭa on the Bhāgīrathī, helped by King Danujamardana. Eighteen daughters and five sons; the youngest son Mukunda was the father of Kumāradeva, father of Rūpa, Sanātana and Anupama (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Not Padmanābha Cakravartī, father of Lokanātha Gosvāmī.
